brief_analysis.core_objective: Launch a new nitro canned cold brew with a high-energy, premium cinematic spot optimized for viral retention.
brief_analysis.target_audience: Urban young professionals and coffee enthusiasts aged 22-38.
brief_analysis.aesthetic_tone: Dark, sleek, tactile, cinematic, high-contrast, moody, sophisticated.

treatment.logline: A sensory journey into the velvet texture of Solstice Nitro, where darkness meets the sharp, refreshing snap of nitrogen-infused coffee.
treatment.visual_direction: High-speed phantom camera work (1000fps) to capture liquid viscosity. Lighting utilizes hard, directional rim lighting to emphasize condensation on matte black surfaces. Color grade is crushed blacks with subtle cool blue highlights and warm, rich espresso brown tones.
ai_previs_prompts: Macro shot of a matte black aluminum can, condensation droplets, dramatic rim lighting, dark moody studio background, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, shot on Arri Alexa 35, 100mm macro lens --ar 16:9
Extreme close up of nitro cold brew swirling in a glass, dark espresso liquid, cascading bubbles, high contrast, cinematic, sharp focus, volumetric lighting --ar 9:16

shot_list.scene_location: INT. Studio - High Speed Macro Rig
shot_list.visual_action: Extreme macro pull shot of a can tab popping, releasing an explosive plume of pressurized cold nitrogen mist directly into the camera lens. On-screen text: 'THIS ISN'T NORMAL COFFEE ⚡'
shot_list.audio_vo: Hyper-crisp metallic snap followed by a loud, pressurized nitrogen blast and heavy bass drop.

shot_list.visual_action: A hand slams the matte black Solstice can onto a block of clear ice, shattering it into a spray of crystal shards. On-screen text: 'NO WATER. NO SUGAR. PURE NITRO.'
shot_list.audio_vo: Loud, hyper-crisp ice-shattering crack layered with deep sub-bass vibration.

shot_list.visual_action: Nitro cold brew pouring into a glass, showing the cascading waterfall effect of micro-bubbles forming a thick velvet head. On-screen text: 'VELVET SMOOTH ENERGY'
shot_list.audio_vo: Velvety, bubbling liquid sound design with deep, smooth ambient synth.

shot_list.visual_action: The can sits on a dark slate surface, dramatic light catching the metallic logo. High-contrast endcard overlay appears. On-screen text: 'CLAIM YOUR FREE 4-PACK NOW — TAP BELOW BEFORE STOCK RUNS OUT ⚡'
shot_list.audio_vo: Voiceover: 'Solstice Nitro. Experience the dark side of energy. Tap below to claim your free 4-pack now.'

budget_breakdown.line_item: Creative direction, storyboarding, and hook optimization analysis
Director, DP, Gaffer, and Food/Beverage Stylist
High-speed camera rental (Phantom VEO) and specialty macro lighting package
Editing, high-retention text animation, color grading, and tactile sound design
Generative visual asset previs and texture enhancement
